subject: MAP: NovaMed evaluation — deployment lane & region alignment
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@novamed.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T09:15:00-07:00
Subject: MAP kickoff: deployment lanes (hosted/dedicated/private) + region ask

Hi Maria —

Great to meet earlier. Per our call, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that lays out the evaluation tracks, acceptance criteria, and a proposed close timeline that aligns procurement, security review, and a 2-week technical POC. High-level asks:

- Please confirm primary constraint on deployment mode: PHI/data residency needs vs. throughput/latency SLO.
- If PHI mandates exist, call that out (we assume US-only; we can also support a private on-prem option).
- Confirm target cutover quarter and any procurement/PO cycles we should map to.

Attachments: NovaMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (MAP w/ milestones & owners)

Proposed timeline (brief):
- Week 0: MAP signoff + SOW/Procurement kickoff
- Weeks 1–2: POC (dedicated pool, US-East)
- Weeks 3–6: Security evidence collection + escalation gating
- Week 8: Final decision (hosted vs dedicated vs private) + rollout plan

Karthik/Ben — I’ve marked a few technical questions inside the sheet (networking, expected QPS, data retention TTL). Can you review and add estimates by EOD Tuesday?

Maria — happy to hop on a quick 30-min alignment call tomorrow if that helps.

Best,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

---
Attachment: NovaMed_MAP_v1.xlsx (xlsx)
From: Maria Lopez <maria.lopez@novamed.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Rajesh Singh <rajesh.singh@novamed.com>, Procurement Team <procurement@novamed.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment lanes (hosted/dedicated/private) + region ask

Thanks Aisha — this is helpful. A few clarifications from our side:

- Data residency/regulatory: NovaMed will need PHI to remain in US-only environments for the first phase. Our security team leans toward either Dedicated (isolated GPU pool in our cloud tenancy) or Private (VPC/on-prem) depending on the legal carveouts. Hosted is acceptable only if we can get SOC2 + contractual language on data handling.
- Latency: our user-facing workload targets p95 < 300ms for short-response flows; some batch clinical jobs can tolerate higher latency.
- Procurement: typical enterprise PO cycle is ~6 weeks post-SOW. We need a draft SOW to start that clock.

Can you also include a quick cost delta between dedicated vs private for an expected baseline of ~20k tokens/day (mix of generations + embeddings) and a 4-core inference profile? Simple back-of-envelope is fine for now.

We can do the alignment call 10/13 10:30am ET — Rajesh will join to talk infra.

Cheers,
Maria Lopez
Director of Cloud Engineering
NovaMed Health Systems

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T14:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment lanes (hosted/dedicated/private) + region ask

Aisha / Ben — quick technical notes after scanning the MAP and Maria's constraints:

- For PHI (US-only) and p95 < 300ms, Dedicated (customer-dedicated GPU pool in our cloud account) is the cleanest tradeoff: predictable latency and isolated cache. Private on-prem is fully supported but adds ~3–6 week integration work for networking and secrets (KMS/HSM) and will push timelines.
- Cost delta (very rough): hosted (shared): baseline monthly ~$8k; dedicated (reserved): ~$22k–28k depending on commit; private (on-prem) implementation effort one-time ~ $40k–$70k + infra costs. I’ll attach a short estimate spreadsheet after rounding.
- POC recommendation: run a 2-week Dedicated POC in us-east with 2 reserved nodes + burst for heavy batch. This validates latency and throughput while keeping data in US region.

I’ll prepare a short technical appendix and cost note for the MAP and SOW draft.

—Karthik
VP, Serving Runtime — Redwood Inference

Attachment: internal_cost_estimates_novamed.csv (csv)
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>

Date: 2026-10-13T13:47:00-07:00
Subject: Re: MAP kickoff: deployment lanes (hosted/dedicated/private) + region ask

Maria / Rajesh — thanks for the alignment call today. Recap + updated asks below and attached an updated MAP and a first draft SOW stub (SOW will be fleshed out once we confirm the lane).

Recap & next steps: 
1) Deployment lane: short-term recommendation = Dedicated (US-East) POC to satisfy PHI & p95 requirement. Private on-prem remains an option for Phase 2 if legal requires full air gap.
2) POC plan: 2-week technical POC starting 2026-10-25 (tentative) — Redwood will provide 2 reserved nodes and a test harness; NovaMed to provide sample datasets (anonymized) and target test traffic profile.
3) SOW & procurement: attaching NovaMed_SOW_draft_v0.2.pdf for initial procurement review. We recommend starting procurement immediately so PO cycle overlaps security evidence collection.
4) Acceptance criteria (from MAP): p95 <= 300ms across 95% of user flows; functional tests for embeddings/semantic search; security checklist items — SOC2 evidence and network diagrams.

Attachments: NovaMed_MAP_v1.xlsx, NovaMed_SOW_draft_v0.2.pdf

Can procurement confirm the 6-week PO cadence and a primary contracting contact? If yes we’ll push an updated SOW and canonical pricing this Friday.

Regards,
Aisha Rahman
Enterprise Sales — Redwood Inference

Best,
